description: This file defines an interface for a wrapper around GLib functions, including methods for object property management, signal handling, memory allocation, and type information. It also includes a factory class for obtaining singleton instances of the wrapper. The file is part of a media server component, specifically related to GStreamer integration, and provides an abstraction layer for GLib operations within the Rialto media server project.
external_methods: gulong gSignalConnect(gpointer, const gchar *, GCallback, gpointer)

classes.name: IGlibWrapper
classes.description: An interface class providing abstract methods for GLib object property management, signal handling, memory management, and type information, intended for implementation by concrete wrapper classes.

classes.name: IGlibWrapperFactory
classes.description: A factory class for creating or retrieving singleton instances of IGlibWrapper, enabling centralized management of GLib wrapper instances.

methods.name: gObjectSet

methods.name: gObjectGet
methods.description: Retrieves properties from a GLib object, supporting multiple property-return location pairs.

methods.description: Looks up the GParamSpec for a specified property of a GObject class.
